component.name: Avatar Texture Optimizer
inspector.help: Add this component on the same object as VRCAvatarDescriptor. Only one is allowed on the whole avatar. Default settings are safe for beginners — open Advanced only if you know what you are doing.
inspector.quality.hint: Higher presets keep more detail and produce larger textures. High is the recommended default.
inspector.whitelist.hint: Any object type is allowed. Every Texture2D referenced by these objects is left untouched. Other textures that share the same UV skip atlasing only.
inspector.platform.hint: Tick a platform to show and edit its override. Unticked platforms use the shared defaults.
error.noDescriptor: Avatar Texture Optimizer must be on the same GameObject as VRCAvatarDescriptor.
error.noDescriptor:description: Move the component onto the avatar root that has VRCAvatarDescriptor.
error.noDescriptor:hint: The avatar root is the object that has VRCAvatarDescriptor.
error.multiple: More than one Avatar Texture Optimizer was found. Baking aborted.
error.multiple:description: An avatar and its children may only have a single Avatar Texture Optimizer.
error.multiple:hint: Remove the extra components and keep one on the avatar root.
warn.skippedTransform: Texture '{0}' skipped: UV transform, wrap-crossing, or special use detected.
warn.skippedTransform:description: The texture is treated as whitelisted so the avatar appearance stays correct.
warn.skippedTransform:hint: Remove tiling/offset/rotation (including animation) or add it to the whitelist on purpose.
warn.shaderUnknown: Shader '{0}' could not be fully analyzed. Related textures were skipped.
warn.shaderUnknown:description: ATO refused to guess unknown shader semantics.
warn.shaderUnknown:hint: Register an IATOShaderAnalyzer or whitelist the material.
warn.packFailed: Texture '{0}' and its UV group could not fit the largest atlas. Atlasing skipped.
warn.packFailed:description: Islands were quality-scaled and then processed without atlasing.
warn.packFailed:hint: Disable atlasing, raise max atlas size, or split the mesh.
warn.formatFallback: Format '{0}' is unsafe for '{1}'. Fell back to '{2}'.
warn.formatFallback:description: A user-selected compression format was rejected to protect the material.
warn.formatFallback:hint: Pick a format that matches the texture type (alpha / gray / normal).
warn.uvWrap: UV of '{0}' crosses the wrap seam and cannot be normalized. Skipped.
warn.uvWrap:description: Out-of-range UVs that depend on Repeat sampling are not remapped.
warn.uvWrap:hint: Unwrap the mesh into 0-1 or whitelist the renderer.
info.report:hint: Enable Verbose Logging on the component to print per-stage details in the Console.
progress.quality: ATO: Scaling islands to target quality
